description: phpMyFAQ versions before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 have an authentication bypass vulnerability. This occurs because the web installer ignores the legacy config/database.php file during upgrades from version 3.x. An unauthenticated attacker can exploit this to reinstall the site using a database controlled by the attacker, allowing them to create an administrator account and take over the application.
